create_EQAEpisode: create an EQAEpisode with a QuestionData object containing question text and answer token
build_QuestionSensor: build a QuestionSensor that returns question tokens from an EQAEpisode as token IDs
implement_CorrectAnswer_measure: implement a CorrectAnswer measure that stores the episode answer token as the metric
run_EQATask: run an EQATask by stepping navigation actions then submitting an AnswerAction with an answer ID
review_AnswerAccuracy_measure: review the AnswerAccuracy measure that compares the agent answer ID against the episode answer token
